_readme: Fixture for the Client Engine screen. Shape defined in ../contract.md. Codex builds against THIS FILE; swapping it for the live endpoint is a one-line change. Wolfpack states are lifted from aom-commercial-trades-engine.html (2026-07-30) and every one is confidence:guessed because the doc itself says to turn the guesses into facts. Ambition is unaudited. Kohrs' program is proposed, not ratified.

steps.label: Find the portfolio
steps.blurb: Every high-value account is a portfolio: one relationship, many properties, recurring work.

steps.label: Manufacture the meeting
steps.blurb: A reverse trade show seats you across a table for about $150. You are buying an appointment, not an impression.

steps.label: Win the walk away
steps.blurb: You do not get the contract in the room. You get it in the 48 hours after.

steps.label: Prove it with their own work
steps.blurb: One shoot day gives a year of material.

steps.label: Report in their numbers
steps.blurb: Lead with the metric the owner already watches. Never a marketing metric they have to be taught to care about.

coverage.label: Google the company name
coverage.bar: One company, not two. Complete profile, commercial photos, real hours.

coverage.label: Glance at the reviews
coverage.bar: Enough of them, recent, naming commercial work and the city.

coverage.label: Click through to the site
coverage.bar: Management team, commercial proof, named clients, credentials, works on a phone.

coverage.label: Look up the person they met
coverage.bar: Real photo, right title, company linked, posts that are not from 2019.

coverage.label: Check the company page
coverage.bar: Active, branded, the meet-the-team videos living there.

coverage.label: Look at whatever they were handed
coverage.bar: A capability folder that answers the vendor questions, not a business card.

coverage.label: Wait for a follow up
coverage.bar: An email inside 24 hours, specific to what was discussed, credentials attached.

coverage.label: Ask for insurance and licensing
coverage.bar: Certificate, license and W-9 inside the hour, correctly named.

coverage.label: Ask around, or ask an AI
coverage.bar: Named references who will take the call. Turning up in answers about Phoenix commercial work.

coverage.label: Is there footage to cut
coverage.bar: Unedited job-site footage in hand, logged and proxied.

coverage.label: Is the edit backlog current
coverage.bar: No delivered shoot waiting more than two weeks for its edit pass.

coverage.label: Is approval moving
coverage.bar: Nothing sitting unapproved with the client for more than five days.

coverage.label: Is it actually posting
coverage.bar: Live on Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn at the agreed cadence.

coverage.label: Is the next shoot booked
coverage.bar: A date on the calendar before the current footage runs out.

coverage.label: Does the owner see results
coverage.bar: A report in the owner's own numbers, on a schedule they expect.

gate.rule: Do not book a single meeting until the surfaces are green. Paying $150 a seat to send a property manager to a placeholder website converts a warm introduction into a documented reason to say no.
